note: Every judgement call the engines make that is not a published constant (SAP formula, U-values, catalogue costs, emission factors live in their own sourced files). Change a value here and the engine key changes, so cached results are recomputed. Shown on the How it works page.

energy.heat_utilisation.used_for: Physics-only heat estimate (no meters): share of degree-day heat loss actually delivered as heating.
energy.heat_utilisation.why: Homes are not heated to the base temperature all day or in every room; SAP-style intermittency/utilisation factors sit around 0.8-0.9.

energy.gas_heating_share_fallback.used_for: Splitting gas into space heating vs. hot water/cooking ONLY when the degree-day regression on the home's own meters is unavailable.
energy.gas_heating_share_fallback.why: Space heating is roughly three-quarters of domestic gas in Great Britain.
energy.gas_heating_share_fallback.source: DESNZ Energy Consumption in the UK (ECUK), domestic end use tables

energy.electric_heating_share_fallback.used_for: Same split for electrically heated homes when the meter regression is unavailable.
energy.electric_heating_share_fallback.why: In electrically heated homes heating is the largest single end use, a little over half of demand.
energy.electric_heating_share_fallback.source: DESNZ ECUK domestic end use; storage-heater tariff studies (approximation)

energy.cooking_gas_share_of_baseload.used_for: Gas used for cooking (not hot water) in gas-heated homes.
energy.cooking_gas_share_of_baseload.why: Hob/oven gas is a small part of non-heating gas; the rest heats water.
energy.cooking_gas_share_of_baseload.source: Engineering judgement informed by DESNZ ECUK domestic end-use shares (approximation)

energy.cooking_gas_max_kwh.why: Typical gas cooking is a few hundred kWh a year at most.

energy.hot_water_max_share_of_electric_b.used_for: Cap on electric hot water inferred from non-heating electricity, so appliances are never assigned zero.
energy.hot_water_max_share_of_electric_b.why: Guard rail against attributing all baseload to hot water.

solar.self_consumption_low_demand_kwh.used_for: Demand at or below which solar self-consumption is at the catalogue minimum.
solar.self_consumption_low_demand_kwh.why: Low-use homes are out during the day and export most generation.
solar.self_consumption_low_demand_kwh.source: Energy Saving Trust solar self-consumption guidance (approximation)

solar.self_consumption_high_demand_kwh.used_for: Demand at or above which self-consumption reaches the catalogue maximum.
solar.self_consumption_high_demand_kwh.why: High daytime demand (e.g. a heat pump) absorbs more generation.
solar.self_consumption_high_demand_kwh.source: Energy Saving Trust solar self-consumption guidance (approximation)

solar.self_consumption_max_share_of_dema.used_for: Solar can never offset more than this share of a home's electricity demand without a battery.
solar.self_consumption_max_share_of_dema.why: Generation and demand do not coincide (evenings, winter).
solar.self_consumption_max_share_of_dema.source: Energy Saving Trust; MCS self-consumption tables (approximation)

nba.cost_floor_gbp.used_for: "Value for money" divides carbon saved by mid cost, never by less than this.
nba.cost_floor_gbp.why: Below about £1k the price is not what decides; without a floor a £250 thermostat outranks every fabric measure on a tiny denominator.

nba.min_carbon_kg.used_for: A measure saving less than this is not proposed as the one thing to do first.
nba.min_carbon_kg.why: Leading with a negligible saving would waste the customer's attention.

nba.suitability_weight.used_for: Down-weights less suitable measures when choosing what to do first.
nba.suitability_weight.why: A slightly smaller saving that is very likely to work beats a larger one that may not.

calibration.real_evidence_min_homes.used_for: Minimum number of real retrofitted homes (DESNZ NEED) before their measured savings replace the simulator-learned calibration for a measure.
calibration.real_evidence_min_homes.why: Below this the real estimate's interval is too wide to override the model.
calibration.real_evidence_min_homes.source: Design choice; see reports/REAL_DATA.md for each measure's interval
